svg.title: ExecuTorch Export Recipes
svg.desc: An agent-first harness and collection of model recipes. Export, validate, and optimize models for the edge. Navy and cornflower palette with Aeonik and DM Mono typography from React Native ExecuTorch. Lettering is outlined so the image needs no installed fonts.
